items.t: Wants to pass a bill that cuts income taxes for all earners.
items.q: Wisconsin Senate Majority Leader Devin LeMahieu wants to pass a bill that will cut income taxes for all earners.

items.t: Called his flat tax measure a "once-in-a-lifetime opportunity" for generational tax reform, citing the state's high surplus.
items.q: LeMahieu on Tuesday called his flat tax measure a "once-in-a-lifetime opportunity" to make generational tax reform given the state’s high surplus.

items.t: Said a tax proposal would be targeted at middle class families.
items.q: The proposal will be targeted at middle class families in an attempt to win the support of Democratic Gov. Tony Evers, who has vetoed past tax cuts that applied to taxpayers earning up to about $405,000, Senate Majority Leader Devin LeMahieu said.

items.t: Said the latest plan would generally lower the tax rate from 5.3% to 4.4% on income between about $36,000 and around $200,000 for families.
items.q: in general it would lower the tax on income between about $36,000 and around $200,000 for families from 5.3% to 4.4%, LeMahieu said

items.t: Said he did not like tax cuts that "choose winners and losers" and favors a broad reduction for all taxpayers.
items.q: But LeMahieu said he didn't like tax cuts that "choose winners and losers" and instead favors a broad reduction for all taxpayers.

items.t: Said he thinks a medical marijuana bill could pass this legislative session if regulations ensure it is for those in serious pain.
items.q: he thinks a bill to create a medical marijuana program in the state could be passed this legislative session as long as regulations are put forward to ensure it’s for those in serious pain.

record.t: Appointed Robert Spindell to the state's bipartisan elections commission.
record.q: Democrats in the Wisconsin Senate are pushing for the rescission of Majority Leader Devin LeMahieu's appointment of Robert Spindell to the state's bipartisan elections commission.

record.t: Circulated a proposal for co-sponsors that would phase in a flat income tax rate of 3.25% by 2026.
record.q: Republican Senate Majority Leader Devin LeMahieu's proposal, which he circulated for co-sponsors on Friday, would phase in a flat income tax rate of 3.25% by 2026.
